A pattern requiring 'CONSOLE' + one-char-from-{l,o,g} immediately after can never match a real console line, which always has a literal '[' there. This is an unescaped-regex-metacharacter defect in the ISSUER's own amended <expect> text (introduced when quoting ui-smoke's literal 'CONSOLE[' + type + ']:' prefix format), not a defect in the print-route repair, the fixture, or this criterion's actual output. Recorded as surprise IRPT_FNTEND-W1-S14 rather than silently marking PASS against a criterion the mechanical checker cannot honestly agree matches; per proof-of-spec-check.py's own rule (spine v3 L7), 'the match decides a mechanical criterion, not the worker.'
